articles.title: DHS’s predictive policing is unconstitutional, un-American and should be stopped
articles.snippet: Targeting Americans based on what their spending habits can tell us about their politics is an abuse of our financial system, writes Coin Center’s Laz Pieper.

articles.title: S&P Global to acquire blockchain security platform OpenZeppelin
articles.snippet: S&P Global agreed to buy OpenZeppelin, which says its smart contracts have facilitated more than $37 trillion in value transfers.

articles.title: Microsoft Staff Asked If AI Scraping Was 'Largest Theft of Labor in Human History'
articles.snippet: Internal memos warned of a "doom loop" threatening the quality of the very models it was building with OpenAI.

articles.title: Andrew Yang Calls for AI Kill Switch as Safety Fears Mount
articles.snippet: The former presidential candidate said lawmakers should impose liability rules and waiting periods on frontier AI firms as autonomous agents raise new cyber and labor concerns.

articles.title: House Committee Advances US Bitcoin Reserve Bill on Party-Line Split
articles.snippet: A substitute text adopted before the vote strips out the Federal Reserve funding routes and thins the transparency rules.
